notes.content: The B.A. in Natural Sciences Earth Science Option serves to establish subject matter competency through coursework as approved by the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing (CTC), which waives the California Subject Exam for Teachers (CSET), and streamlines the process for students to enter the Single Subject Teaching Credential program in Science. This degree program is primarily designed for students who plan to become middle or high school science teachers; however, the program is also suitable for students who have interest in other science career options. Please contact CSM Advising and Resources Center (ARC) at 559.278.4150 for advising and more information, and other areas for which the breadth of scientific coverage of this degree is advantageous. Advising Notes In compliance with Federal Requirements for Posting Licensure and Certification Eligibility, please see the CSU Chancellor’s Office calstate.edu website . In addition to the major program requirements, every student must also complete the University’s baccalaureate degree requirements such as: American Government and Institutions ( PLSI 2 ) General Education Requirements (43 units) This total assumes that students in this option will maximize 12 units required for the major that also may be applied to fulfill General Education requirements as follows: CHEM 1A (Area 5A), BIOL 1A (Area 5B), EES 168 (Area UD 2/UD 5), and MATH 75 (Area 2). Consult your major advisor for details. Additional University Graduation Requirements (9 units) Upper-Division Writing Requirement General Education, Additional University Graduation Requirements, and Upper-division Writing courses can be double counted with major requirements. See advisor for details. Sufficient Elective Units to Meet Required Total Units (varies); it is recommended that units in this area be utilized to complete a second major or minor. A full description of the University’s graduation requirements can be found in the Baccalaureate Degree Requirements .

The B.A. in Natural Sciences Earth Science Option serves to establish subject matter competency through coursework as approved by the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing (CTC), which waives the California Subject Exam for Teachers (CSET), and streamlines the process for students to enter the Single Subject Teaching Credential program in Science. This degree program is primarily designed for students who plan to become middle or high school science teachers; however, the program is also suitable for students who have interest in other science career options. Please contact CSM Advising and Resources Center (ARC) at 559.278.4150 for advising and more information, and other areas for which the breadth of scientific coverage of this degree is advantageous.


Advising Notes

In compliance with Federal Requirements for Posting Licensure and Certification Eligibility, please see the CSU Chancellor’s Office calstate.edu website.


In addition to the major program requirements, every student must also complete the University’s baccalaureate degree requirements such as:

  • American Government and Institutions (PLSI 2)
  • General Education Requirements (43 units)
  • This total assumes that students in this option will maximize 12 units required for the major that also may be applied to fulfill General Education requirements as follows: CHEM 1A (Area 5A), BIOL 1A (Area 5B), EES 168 (Area UD 2/UD 5), and MATH 75 (Area 2). Consult your major advisor for details.
  • Additional University Graduation Requirements (9 units)
  • Upper-Division Writing Requirement
  • General Education, Additional University Graduation Requirements, and Upper-division Writing courses can be double counted with major requirements. See advisor for details.
  • Sufficient Elective Units to Meet Required Total Units (varies); it is recommended that units in this area be utilized to complete a second major or minor.

A full description of the University’s graduation requirements can be found in the Baccalaureate Degree Requirements.

notes.content: Additional University Graduation Requirements The Additional University Graduation Requirements are designed to complement the GE requirements. It is the policy of Fresno State, that all students will cultivate and refine their affective, cognitive, and physical faculties through studying great works of the human imagination; be equipped for lifelong understanding and development of themselves as integrated physiological, social, and psychological beings; and be prepared to understand and live in a multicultural and international world through their undergraduate education. This will be accomplished through a total of 9 units from the following areas, each requiring 3 units: Arts/Humanities (A/H) - All students are required to take an Arts/Humanities course to graduate at the bachelor’s degree level. Lifelong-Understanding and Self-Development (L/S) - All students are required to take a lifelong understanding and self-development course to for graduate at the bachelor’s degree level. Multicultural/International (M/I) - All Students are required to take a Multicultural / International course at Fresno State to graduate at the bachelor’s degree level.
notes.contentHtml:
Additional University Graduation Requirements


The Additional University Graduation Requirements are designed to complement the GE requirements. It is the policy of Fresno State, that all students will cultivate and refine their affective, cognitive, and physical faculties through studying great works of the human imagination; be equipped for lifelong understanding and development of themselves as integrated physiological, social, and psychological beings; and be prepared to understand and live in a multicultural and international world through their undergraduate education.

This will be accomplished through a total of 9 units from the following areas, each requiring 3 units:

  1. Arts/Humanities (A/H) - All students are required to take an Arts/Humanities course to graduate at the bachelor’s degree level. 
  2. Lifelong-Understanding and Self-Development (L/S) - All students are required to take a lifelong understanding and self-development course to for graduate at the bachelor’s degree level. 
  3. Multicultural/International (M/I) - All Students are required to take a Multicultural / International course at Fresno State to graduate at the bachelor’s degree level.
